rationale: Roberts is likely to assign to Barrett (or Kagan) because their conference framing supplies the majority’s core move: a distributive reading of a negated eligibility screen without “rewriting” and, and a rejection of lenity for lack of grievous ambiguity. Gorsuch is the most likely principal dissenter (Crooks/lenity), with Sotomayor and/or Jackson potentially writing separately to emphasize mandatory-minimum/lenity and fairness concerns.
